title.narrative: Public–Private Partnerships Demonstration Program to Transform Delivery of Elderly Care Services in Yichang, Hubei

description.narrative: The proposed Asian Development Bank (ADB) assistance will be the first sovereign public-private partnerships (PPP)-related loan in the People's Republic of China (PRC) that can potentially transform the delivery of social services by local governments. The PPP Demonstration Program (the program) will build capacity for developing, procuring, and managing transparent PPPs and finance a demonstration PPP for socially inclusive, efficient, and quality elderly care services (ECS) in one municipality (Yichang, Hubei). The program will serve as a demonstration for other local governments, and create more opportunities for ADB to finance inclusive and efficient service delivery in the PRC.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3506: 69% of contracts awarded and 91% disbursed as of 16 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: A review mission was fielded on 31 March-6 April 2022.The implementation progress is about 2 years behind the original schedule. The delay is caused mainly by the (i) prolonged preparation and approval of the feasibility study report resulting from the special PPP and results-based lending features, (ii) frequent staff changes in the executing and implementing agencies and the ADB project team leader at the start-up stage, (iii) delay in PPP Transaction Advisory Service (TAS) consultant recruitment, (vi) COVID-19 pandemic, (v) unsatisfactory deliverables by the PPP TAS consultants at the transaction structuring stage; and (vi) recent financial difficulties of both contractors. A midterm review mission was fielded on 7-11 November 2022 to review program progress and discuss the proposed 2-year extension of the original loan closing date of 30 June 2023. A review mission was fielded in 20-21 and 28 March 2023. The loan closing date has been extended to 30 June 2025.

Status of Implementation Progress: DLI 1: YMG's program management office (PMO) capacity in PPP design, management, and effective service delivery built. The capacity development is under process and this DLI will be achieved in Q2 2023.
DLI 2: ECS facilities with elderly and environmentally sustainable design features constructed. The prior results and 2017 target (detailed designs for ECS facilities finalized and approved with elderly and environmentally sustainable and inclusive design features) have been achieved. Full achievement of DLI 2 is expected in Q1 2024.
DLI 3: Number of elderly with access to integrated and inclusive ECS facilities increased. The PPP procurement is almost completed. The contract negotiation with the winning bidder is ongoing. Operations commencement in the two ECS facilities is anticipated by June 2024 and DLI3 is expected to be achieved by June 2025. The target number is subject to the reassessment of the private sector operator once in place, as the market conditions have been different with that as appraisal, particularly after the COVID-19 pandemic.
DLI 4: Quality ECS provided through PPP. The key performance indicators and monitoring mechanism have been completed and was verified by a third-party, with partial disbursement of $2 million achieved. The DLI is expected to be fully achieved by 2025, after two performance reviews against the approved key performance indicators.
DLI 5: PPP demonstration achieved. ADB and YMG have approved the ECS PPP model developed by the PPP TAS consultant, with partial disbursement of $1 million made. The PPP TAS consultant will prepare and disseminate the PPP manual by Q3 2023 to fully achieve DLI 5.
